description: What an order would cost: per piece by size, the pieces, any volume discount, shipping, and the total before sales tax (tax is added at checkout where it applies). Nothing is charged. Use the sizes the customer named; a line is one item in one color with a count per size.

item.description: Item key or the word a customer would use (tee, hoodie, mug, tote, cap, polo, long sleeve, crewneck, performance tee, women's tee, youth hoodie, notebook, tumbler). Use list_items for the full set.

sizes.description: Count per size, e.g. {"S": 2, "M": 5, "L": 3}. Every item has a size list in list_items, mugs included (11oz, 15oz).

surfaces.description: How many print areas carry a design: 1 for a design on one area, 2 for a front and a back. Defaults to 1.

title: Price an order
